newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV STEPS UP A GEAR IN LYON GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KAFELNIKOV STEPS UP A GEAR IN LYON GRAND PRIX.

text.p: French Open winner Yevgeny Kafelnikov stepped up a gear to beat Czech Petr Korda 6-4 6-3 in the second round of the Lyon grand prix on Wednesday.
Second seed Kafelnikov had been stretched to the limit to beat another Czech, Daniel Vacek, in three sets in the opening round.
"I played much better than yesterday, it was nearly perfect," he said. "But I'm not at my best yet."
Fourth seed Marcelo Rios of Chile and Swede Thomas Enqvist, seeded fifth, also swept into the third round.
Enqvist, who saved three match points in his first round match against Australia's Jason Stoltenberg, beat Italian qualifier Gianluca Pozzi 6-3 6-3 in an hour.
Rios was even faster in his 6-3 6-2 victory over Sweden's Mikael Tillstroem, who bowed out in just 52 minutes.
